title: Wire SeatState.Bot roster occupancy for bot-filled seats + HumanIdle scenario (TASK-038 AC5 completion)
description: Filed from the TASK-038 review (rev-t038 FULL, MEDIUM M1 + LOW L1). TASK-038 delivered the bot system and proved the AC5 LIVENESS property (a Novato IBotPolicy supplies continuous input driving a real mechanic through a full SessionStateMachine session that reaches GameOver without stalling any phase). BUT the integration test does NOT assign SeatState.Bot — the roster keeps the filled seat Empty, so the bot's input for it is largely inert; what is actually proven is 'bot input doesn't regress FSM liveness', which makes 'fills a seat' functionally thin. Also only the 'Empty' half of AC5's 'Empty/Idle' is exercised; the 'Idle' (HumanIdle) half has no dedicated scenario. SessionStateMachine.CompleteJoin assigns only Human/Empty off real Join claims; wiring an unclaimed seat to SeatState.Bot is explicit future work the FSM's own class doc defers past TASK-038. WORK: (1) Wire SeatState.Bot roster occupancy so an unclaimed/idle seat is actually OCCUPIED by a Novato bot (roster state = Bot + a published avatar), so the bot genuinely fills the seat rather than feeding inert input to an Empty slot, driving it through a full session that reaches GameOver with no stall. (2) Add a HumanIdle seat-fill scenario (a claimed-then-idle seat handed to a bot) covering the 'Idle' half of AC5. (3) Confirm SeatState.Bot occupancy interoperates with the TASK-056 dead-seat tracker (which currently watches only claimed Human seats) without regression. (4) Fold in rev-t038 LOW-1: EsquivaBotPolicy.cs:30's doc claims the extended diagnosis is 'still present verbatim on Barcade.SlowTests.Oracles.EsquivaEscapeBot', but that file was DELETED in b7282cc — correct the stale present-tense cross-ref (content already summarized on EsquivaBotPolicy's own doc, nothing lost). Read the SessionStateMachine roster/SeatState code + TASK-038's Core/Runtime/Bots/ module. Core/session logic is fast-testable.
acceptance_criteria: An unclaimed (Empty) seat is occupied by a Novato bot with SeatState.Bot roster state and a published avatar, and the bot genuinely drives that seat (not inert input to an Empty slot) through a full session that reaches GameOver without stalling any phase
A HumanIdle seat-fill scenario (a claimed-then-idle seat handed to a bot) is covered by an integration test — the 'Idle' half of AC5
SeatState.Bot occupancy interoperates with the TASK-056 dead-seat tracker without regression (the tracker's claimed-Human assumption is reconciled)
rev-t038 LOW-1 doc fix applied: EsquivaBotPolicy.cs:30's stale present-tense cross-ref to the deleted EsquivaEscapeBot is corrected. Tests-first where engine-free; fast suite green, no regression

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
CLOSED (loop iter 5) — tdd, depth FULL. All 4 ACs met; fresh-context review rev-t069 APPROVE-WITH-NITS (no HIGH); orchestrator fast-suite gate independently 842/0.

DELIVERY: wired genuine SeatState.Bot roster occupancy into SessionStateMachine.CompleteJoin (unclaimed seats -> Bot + published avatar, no longer inert Empty) + HumanIdle handoff scenario + TASK-056 interop proof + rev-t038 LOW-1 doc fix. Commits: 8d7e3fe (tests, genuine BEHAVIORAL red 'Expected Bot but was Empty') / 673e7eb (feat: CompleteJoin bot-fill + class-doc + EsquivaBotPolicy doc). Fast 840->842 (+2, 0 regressions).

REGRESSION AUDIT of the shared CompleteJoin change (rev-t069 traced every FSM-roster consumer firsthand — higher blast radius than a leaf mechanic): PayoutEligibleSeatsMask excludes Empty+HumanIdle so Bot is payout-eligible (intended per AC1); ActiveSeatsMask includes Bot; dead-seat tracker UpdateDeadSeatTracking guard already excludes Bot by pre-existing construction (method UNTOUCHED by the diff); podium/FinishSessionScoring ranks Bot seats (intended); mechanics engagement (Sujeta/Iguala/Jefe/CoopPhase gate _engaged on Human||Bot) genuinely engages Bot. NO production consumer outside microgames reads the CompleteJoin roster; StagePresenter UAT + BotView build standalone rosters. Existing payout/wager/FinalPlaces tests use all-Human JoinReadyInputs so Empty->Bot can't shift them. The one renamed test (NovatoBot_FillsUnclaimedSeats) was STRENGTHENED (prior 'Azul==Empty' sanity -> 'all 3 unclaimed==Bot' + 'Rojo==Human'), nothing dropped.

AC NON-VACUITY (all verified firsthand): AC1 test drives real Bot.Novato decisions off live GetRenderState for all 4 seats every tick to GameOver then asserts the 3 unclaimed==Bot (genuine end-to-end drive + no phase stall, not a flag read); AC2 HumanIdle honesty — sensor-asserts the seat actually crosses into HumanIdle before the bot handoff, reaches GameOver, asserts Human OR HumanIdle (Or correctly excludes the real failure modes Bot/Empty; not over-loosened, reflects resume-on-flanco); AC3 interop — BotOccupiedSeat_IsNeverMarkedIdle feeds zero input to ALL seats past 3x threshold, the CLAIMED Rojo DOES go HumanIdle (proves the window is a real test) while the 3 Bot seats never do; AC4 doc fix accurate + doc-only (EsquivaEscapeBot confirmed deleted in b7282cc). [ASSUMED] #2/#3 honest scoping (no new idle->Bot timeout tier invented; no production input driver built — caller's job, same as Human seats).

*** [ASSUMED] #1 FOR HUMAN RATIFICATION (rev-t069 MEDIUM-1, non-blocking — built exactly to AC1, closed on recorded deferral): EVERY unclaimed seat is ALWAYS bot-filled, unconditional, no config. GDD §3.2 line 48 frames this as CONFIGURABLE ('bots novato ruidoso O SE EXCLUYEN, configurable') around a human-presence premise; the hardcode drops both. Consequence: a credit-then-zero-claims session spins up a full 4-bot game. Bounded/non-corrupting (InsertCredit is the ONLY Attract->Join path — an empty bar stays in Attract, can't self-run bots; clean GameOver->Attract reset), so NOT HIGH. FILED as follow-up TASK-080 (add fillEmptySeatsWithBots config + own the configurability in the class doc + human ratifies the default policy). Added to the ratification list. ***

DEFERRED LOW (rev-t069 LOW-1, carried to TASK-080): sibling historical cross-refs to the deleted EsquivaEscapeBot at ReactionDelayBuffer.cs:21, EsquivaMicrogameV2Tests.cs:444/:757 — all past-tense/non-false (NOT the AC4-fixed 'still present verbatim'), optional cleanup only.

NOTE: closes TASK-038 AC5's originally-thin 'fills a seat' + adds the missing HumanIdle half. TASK-078 (coop phase) + TASK-041 epic remain blocked on HIGH-1.
